source_definition.half: Correct orientation necessity, but sufficiency or the all-map naturality check is incomplete.

source_definition.obligation: Discover and prove that all levels from m=3 onwards are exactly all proper ultrafilters; recover every allowed finite observation and the converse.

source_definition.half: A correct full-record ultrafilter classification is proved, but stabilization at three is only asserted, or a material direction of the threshold proof is absent.
